{{Hatnote|For the [[Coruscant]] Light Side objective, see [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One]].}}
'''Hyperdrive''' is a custom ''Star Wars'' CCG format designed by [[Owen Strombeck]].<ref name="hd" /> Each player chooses two 27-card theme packs, selects starting cards, and shuffles the rest into a deck.<ref name="hd" /> Strombeck published it as a Jumpstart-style environment: modified [[Decipher]] cards, new cards, and a shortened ruleset.<ref name="hd" />

* '''Designed by:''' [[Owen Strombeck]]
* '''Publisher:''' [[Owen Strombeck]]
* '''Type:''' custom constructed (no deckbuilding)
* '''Deck:''' two theme packs (54 cards)
* '''Rules:''' ''Star Wars CCG Hyperdrive v2.0'', 16 August 2025<ref name="rules" />

The format is not a championship era. Championship [[Template:Card|Versions]] lists do not include Hyperdrive printings. A modified Decipher face in this format is a new card identity in Hyperdrive.

== Pack composition ==
Each pack has 27 cards: a system, a related site, a thematic Effect that can be started, then a mix of characters or vehicles, starships, weapons, and interrupts.<ref name="hd" /><ref name="rules" />

== Rules changes ==
Systems have no parsec numbers. A starship either has a hyperdrive or does not, shown by the Astromech icon. A ship with a hyperdrive may move from any starting system to any other system in one normal move.<ref name="rules" />
